channel.title: Leisure and hospitality: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the leisure and hospitality sector.

item.title: Paradise: Paradise's Q3 2026 preliminary consolidated revenue was KRW 351.7bn, with operating profit of KRW 64.1bn, up 62.3% year on year.
Grand Korea Leisure: GKL reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 109.7bn and operating profit of KRW 9.6bn, down 44.4% year on year.
Paradise: Paradise reported October 2026 casino revenue of KRW 82.1bn, up 12.8% year on year and down 4.6% from September.
Grand Korea Leisure: GKL reported October 2026 casino revenue of KRW 29.3bn, up 2.5% year on year and down 21.5% from September.
